entries.097c74d56180921b: A holding company centered on the purchase and sale of used items such as branded goods, jewelry and watches, which also handles tire and wheel sales and real estate leasing.
entries.0c1b9ba4233121e5: It handles second-hand goods centered on jewelry and precious metals, watches, bags, fashion products and others. It buys second-hand goods from general customers through buying centers, event buying, visiting buying and mail-in buying, sells them through its stores and EC, and also operates corporate auctions and provides brokerage through group companies. It also sells tires and wheels and leases out stores.
entries.0f73afc268ed02a0: Revenue comes from sales of second-hand and new goods, corporate sales through auctions, and sales of tires and wheels, among others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥221,707 million, up 39.4% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. By business, the Brand and Fashion Business accounted for ¥215,146 million, the Tire and Wheel Business for ¥6,523 million, and the Real Estate Leasing Business for ¥365 million.

entries.5bbff594d8533d1c: This is a reportable segment that plans, researches and develops, manufactures, sells and provides services for passenger car tires and wheels, and automotive accessories and parts. Kurafuto Co., Ltd. operates tire and wheel specialty stores, and Auto Parts Japan Co., Ltd. operates 'U-ICHIBAN', a specialty store for the sale and purchase of used tires and wheels. Four by Four Engineering Service Co., Ltd. plans, researches and develops, manufactures and sells original wheels. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,523 million.
entries.6edaf2fe428e2b5e: By net sales, the Brand and Fashion Business accounted for ¥215,146 million, or about 97% of the total, the Tire and Wheel Business ¥6,523 million, and the Real Estate Leasing Business ¥365 million. By region, Japan is the main market, and the company also sells in Asia, the United States and Europe. While the reuse market continues to expand, competition in buying and selling is intensifying, the company recognizes.

entries.88be0d112b627260: Its MISSION (purpose of existence) is 'By respecting the people who make products, appreciating those who pass them on, and providing excitement to those who receive them, we will create empathy for a recycling-oriented society,' and its VISION (desired image) is 'Turning relay use from an idea into a culture.' Its medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ending March 2028 as its final year, lists 'business expansion through M＆A' as one of the pillars of its growth strategy; for the Brand and Fashion Business, it states that it will work on strengthening individual buying and diversifying touchpoints, diversifying sales channels and promoting OMO, expanding platforms for corporate transactions and auctions, and accelerating global expansion and building a 'global reuse chain.'

In Japan, Komehyo Co., Ltd., K-Brand Off Co., Ltd., R-K Enterprise Co., Ltd. and others purchase goods from general customers (individual purchases) and from corporations handling used goods, and sell them through stores and EC. Overseas, subsidiaries in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, the United States and others sell used goods, and iShopShops, Inc. in the United States operates a live commerce platform. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥215,146 million, the largest of the 3 reportable segments.
